en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street scene in a small town. On the left and right are two- to three‑story masonry buildings with tall windows and simple classical detailing. A railing and stone-lined waterway or bridge are visible in the foreground, leading toward a gently rising street with horse-drawn traffic and pedestrians. Leafless trees line the street. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Åmål as seen from Kungsbron (King's Bridge) looking along Kungsgatan (King Street). The publisher's imprint appears on the lower right.
